This small plot I keep for mixed crops, not the main maize field. Since I intercrop here, I put my small share of fertilizer mostly on the maize plot — this one I help with manure from the goats and chickens we keep at home. I did not get enough coupon this year for all my plots, so on this one I use my own saved seed like my father did. I will weed with my wife and children, no money to hire people for this small piece.
